title: Clarify internal SSH client responsibility boundaries
description:
The cohesion review found healthy repository-level package boundaries but excessive responsibility overlap inside client. Prefer modest internal decomposition over a broad package reorganization.

client/config_sources.go combines precedence, config traversal, path expansion, bounded filesystem reads, directive admission, identity/trust defaults and environment selection. Its readSource helper is also used by authentication and trust code. client/auth.go contains legacy trust evaluation and a legacy trust writer, while authentication selection lives in identity.go. The new trust path has a separate parser and guarded persistence. Their deliberate policy differences are not obvious from current file organization.

Keep the public client facade and clarify four areas: configuration compilation; authentication ownership; trust evaluation/persistence; CLI compatibility and terminal interaction. Start with same-package files and narrow private types. Move/rename shared source-reading and legacy trust code to reflect actual responsibility. Coordinate with the resolved-plan task rather than creating duplicate ownership abstractions.

Share mechanisms only where semantics match. Preserve CLI versus Dial trust differences, explicit local authority, cancellation, secret clearing and connection ownership. Retain independent client/sshd packages, optional Mosh boundaries, the terminal process reaper and the single Go module. Update architecture documentation and run existing behavior/race tests; avoid arbitrary uniform file/package sizes or unnecessary package depth.
